From 9648f1c3739505557d94ff749a4f32192ea81fe3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Feb 2022 10:15:04 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/guc/slpc: Correct the param count for unset param

SLPC unset param H2G only needs one parameter - the id of the
param.

Fixes: 025cb07bebfa ("drm/i915/guc/slpc: Cache platform frequency limits")

Suggested-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ramalingam C <ramalingam.c@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20220216181504.7155-1-vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
index 13b27b8ff74e..ba21ace973da 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c
@@ -110,7 +110,7 @@ static int guc_action_slpc_unset_param(struct intel_guc *guc, u8 id)
 {
 	u32 request[] = {
 		GUC_ACTION_HOST2GUC_PC_SLPC_REQUEST,
-		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 2),
+		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
 		id,
 	};
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/gt/uc/intel_guc_slpc.c`**
   - The parameter count for the `SLPC_EVENT` function call within the `guc_action_slpc_unset_param` function was changed from `2` to `1`. This reflects that the SLPC unset parameter H2G only requires the ID of the parameter, correcting the previous implementation.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `intel_guc_slpc.c` directly addresses a bug related to the parameter count for the SLPC unset parameter functionality. The change ensures that the function correctly reflects the requirement of only needing one parameter (the ID), which is crucial for the proper operation of the SLPC feature. This fix is linked to a previous commit (025cb07bebfa) that introduced the caching of platform frequency limits, indicating that the bug arose from that earlier change.

Here is the commit message:
drm/i915/guc/slpc: Correct the param count for unset param

SLPC unset param H2G only needs one parameter - the id of the
param.

Fixes: 025cb07bebfa ("drm/i915/guc/slpc: Cache platform frequency limits")

Suggested-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Vinay Belgaumkar <vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Umesh Nerlige Ramappa <umesh.nerlige.ramappa@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ramalingam C <ramalingam.c@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20220216181504.7155-1-vinay.belgaumkar@intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect parameter count in the `SLPC_EVENT` function call within the `guc_action_slpc_unset_param` function, which mistakenly specified that two parameters were needed instead of the correct one (the ID of the parameter). This discrepancy led to improper handling of the SLPC unset parameter functionality.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int guc_action_slpc_unset_param(struct intel_guc *guc, u8 id)
 {
 	u32 request[] = {
 		GUC_ACTION_HOST2GUC_PC_SLPC_REQUEST,
-		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 2),
+		SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
 		id,
 	};
 
 	return intel_guc_send(guc, request, ARRAY_SIZE(request));
 }

```c

```
Reason:
The `SLPC_EVENT` function call incorrectly specifies that two parameters are needed instead of the correct one. This mismatch causes the SLPC unset parameter functionality to be handled improperly, leading to potential errors in the parameter unset operation.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
SLPC_EVENT(SLPC_EVENT_PARAMETER_UNSET, 1),
```
Reason:
The patch corrects the parameter count in the `SLPC_EVENT` function call to one, which is the correct number of parameters required (the ID of the parameter). This ensures that the SLPC unset parameter functionality operates as intended, resolving the issue.
